name: Kamiyama Reika
source: Bubbly and cheerful, Reika is a housewife in her sixth year of marriage.  Her husband is twenty-six years old.  She lives a normal, everyday life with her husband, but the couple's activities are in a rut.  Worried that she is no longer attractive, she decides to try to take some actions to help her step out of her comfort zone.
